headline: You're gaining when you should lose—flip it today.
summary: You're at +0.02 kg/week when you need -0.86 kg/week; today's discipline sets your week's trajectory.
details: Stop emotional snacking before Friday hits—stick to Huel portions and avoid triggering foods in your home today. Do 45 minutes on the rowing machine this morning to establish momentum and accountability. Monday matters most: one strong week of -0.86 kg loss proves you can hit your 88 kg target by June 8th, 2027.
